senses.gloss: Tomara (mss. sometimes Tomala), n. of a Licchavi leader: Mv 〔i.254.13 ff.〕; 〔288.6〕. Probably a family or gotra name, since the person uses the pl. Tomarāṇām (of whom he is one) in 〔256.3〕.
tomara-graha, m., the art of wielding a lance: ˚haḥ Mvy 〔4984〕; ˚he, in lists of martial arts: Divy 〔58.25〕; 〔100.11〕.
